question: Indiana 2027 HCBS waiver income cap
note: Indiana had not posted a 2027 cap as of 2026-10-14. 300% of the 2027 SSI FBR ($1,029) implies about $3,087, UNCONFIRMED; the waiver registry entry carries that as a successor note, never as a figure. On publication this becomes a superseded-figure card for waiver_income_cap.
